successors.name: Avar Khaganate
successors.text: 'the Don-Azov steppe zone, the Kutrigurs in the Western part': the steppe on the western side of the Sea of Azov and the lower Dnieper

ledger.x: About 561: the Avars take the Pontic steppe.
About 561: the Kutrigur realm is absorbed.

wars.name: Kutrigur invasion of the Balkans
wars.outcome: Zabergan crosses the frozen Danube in the winter of 558 and attacks Constantinople in March 559 with 7,000 horsemen; Belisarius defeats him at Melantias and he withdraws.

wars.name: Utigur-Kutrigur war
wars.outcome: Justinian 'managed to persuade the Utigur chieftain Sandilch to attack the Kutrigurs, which resulted in the decimation of both' (Zabergan page); 'ultimately the two peoples decimated one another' (Kutrigurs page).

wars.name: Avar conquest of the Pontic steppe
wars.outcome: 'for 20 years to come the Avars, under their Khagan Baian, fought Utigurs and Antes, Gepids and Slavs' (Pohl); they 'conquered and incorporated' the Kutrigurs and Sabirs and 'By 562 the Avars controlled the lower Danube basin and the steppes north of the…

certainty.note: Steppe polity known from Procopius and Menander through the Wikipedia page; no boundary given.
